SEO ATTACK summary for Blue Canvas, 2026-04-08

Live status:
- Blue Canvas homepage is now showing “AI Consultancy Northern Ireland — Real Results”, which is a good fix versus the March gap.
- Live GSC pull failed today because local OAuth creds are broken (`401 Invalid Credentials`, refresh also failing).
- Ahrefs app is currently blocked by Cloudflare verification in this environment, so Ahrefs findings below use the latest stored Ahrefs-derived reports already in the workspace.

Backlink gaps:
- Blue Canvas baseline is still weak: DR 19, 11 referring domains.
- Main benchmark remains brainpool.ai at DR 42 with 555 referring domains.
- That backlink deficit is still the biggest structural weakness.
- Best link opportunities remain:
  - NI/Derry directories
  - Londonderry Chamber, NI Chamber, Catalyst, FSB
  - Clutch, Crunchbase, TechBehemoths, SelectedFirms, TopDevelopers
  - NI/Ireland tech publications like SyncNI and Irish Tech News
- Bottom line: strategy is already known, execution is the bottleneck. Getting from 11 RDs to 30-40+ is the quickest authority win.

Content gaps:
- Competitors still beat Blue Canvas on content depth and commercial assets.
- Biggest missing/under-served pieces:
  - AI Audit page
  - AI Readiness Assessment page/tool
  - proper case study pages
  - industry/vertical landing pages
  - governance/responsible AI content
- iwantmore.ai still looks broader on content architecture and service depth.
- brainpool.ai still has stronger authority plus deeper service/vertical coverage.
